scientific_integrity: The exact germ is supported directly by the primary abstract and independently indexed Introduction/Theorem 1.5 material. The normalization and conductor are proved from the reduced monomial ring via its nine minimal primes and boundary-compatibility description; an exact standalone checker reproduces the component, conductor, fiber-count, and Hilbert-series arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the fixed-threefold semiuniversal deformation germ, not a coarse moduli quotient. The primary full-text route was inaccessible during source inspection, so an equivalent normalization/conductor computation hidden in the full paper remains a residual originality risk.
title: Normalization conductor and branch defect of Wan's Igusa Kuranishi germ
